purpose: Adversarial evaluation matrix for the existing Frankenstein 2.0 Voice-Slice. This is test design only: it creates no new Voice authority and mints no runtime or product credit.

research_basis.finding_used: Streaming ASR conversational state management materially affects utterance-onset errors around long silence/backchannels; use these as explicit reentry stressors rather than resetting every turn.
Full-duplex evaluation must separately exercise pause handling, backchanneling, turn-taking and interruption management.
Natural disfluency, self-correction and multi-step tool use remain discriminative full-duplex failure modes; include them without importing an external orchestrator.

cases.stress: User speaks, long silence occurs, then conversation resumes with a new utterance onset.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: Long silence must not silently reset causal conversation identity or cause stale prior-turn packets to become current; any ASR state reset must be explicit and measurable.
cases.promotion_scope_if_pass: bounded headless ASR + packet/reentry composition only

cases.stress: Short backchannel/filler appears while the user retains the floor.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: A backchannel/HOLD observation must not close or steal the active user turn and must not produce an ANSWER commit before an admitted endpoint.

cases.stress: User interrupts while locally synthesized output is partially produced/consumed.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: Interrupted output must terminalize without commit authority; no producer chunk after the declared cancellation boundary may be accepted by the sink.
cases.promotion_scope_if_pass: bounded headless TTS producer cancellation + packet composition only

cases.stress: New user speech starts while output is active and ASR continues concurrently.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: The new input lineage must be accepted without allowing the interrupted output lineage to remain commit-eligible or own subsequent tool/result state.
cases.promotion_scope_if_pass: bounded headless full-duplex overlap composition only

cases.stress: User begins a tool request, self-corrects before final endpoint, then gives the corrected final request.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: Superseded partial/self-corrected content must not gain durable tool authority; only the admitted final causal turn may own the tool request.

cases.stress: A tool owned by an interrupted turn returns late, both before and after checkpoint/restart.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: Cancelled/stale tool ownership must remain revoked across restart and cannot be resurrected by a late result.

cases.stress: Checkpoint/restart occurs after an admitted final input but before the next output is completed.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: Restart must preserve the exact active turn lineage without duplicating an already admitted packet/output sequence or inventing a second answer authority.

cases.stress: A fully heard output and VoiceOutcome are persisted, then the process is restarted and the close/reentry is replayed.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: A closed session must remain closed; replay must be byte/identity-idempotent and cannot duplicate durable result authority.

cases.stress: Local TTS generates a fixed German utterance into a headless PCM/file sink and is cancelled in a second run.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: Generated PCM must be finite/non-empty and exactly bound to the model/runtime subject; cancellation must prevent later chunks from entering the sink.
cases.promotion_scope_if_pass: bounded local TTS model/PCM runtime only; no audible/heard credit

cases.stress: Many turns approach packet/event/tool resource caps while ASR/TTS fixtures continue.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: Capacity pressure must not silently evict replay/causal identity; the system must fail closed or perform an explicitly causally bound session rollover.

cases.stress: Inject duplicate, reordered and corrupt input/output/checkpoint records into the composed slice.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: Invalid packet/checkpoint input must be rejected atomically without advancing durable causal projections or resurrecting stale state.

cases.stress: Execute the composed ASR/TTS model path with external inference/network disabled during evidence execution.
cases.fail_closed_invariant: Promotion-bearing inference must remain local and exactly bound; any external ASR/TTS/model inference call invalidates the local-runtime claim.
cases.promotion_scope_if_pass: bounded offline local model composition only

tier_policy.S1: Default for model execution, packet fault injection, PCM sinks and resource tests.
tier_policy.S2: Use where service/user/filesystem/restart fidelity is required.
tier_policy.S3: Use for actual kernel reboot or separate-kernel persistence semantics before S4; do not send these tests to the owner workstation merely because reboot is involved.
tier_policy.S4: Reserve for real microphone/speaker, native device enumeration, OS audio/session/desktop permissions, physical perception and final physical one-handoff acceptance.

next_exact_action: Trigger 4/system integration owner should select the smallest high-information subset that exercises real admitted local ASR + headless local TTS inside the same VPS sandbox while reusing the already-closed G4 packet/presence/barge/recovery/reentry authorities. Start with FDX2+FDX3+FDX4+FDX6, then FDX1/FDX5/FDX7/FDX8; do not create new Voice micro-components unless an executed PRODUCT_NEGATIVE proves one is necessary.
